title: Glowing rubber duck
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='body' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff3a0'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffd21f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f0a800'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='head' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7b8'/>
      <stop offset='65%' stop-color='#ffd21f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f5ad00'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='beak' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb84d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff7a1a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- water ripples -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='40' ry='6' fill='#2a6fd6' opacity='0.55'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='28' ry='4' fill='#4b94e8' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M20 66 Q8 60 12 50 Q18 56 26 58 Z' fill='#f0a800' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='70' rx='33' ry='24' fill='url(#body)' stroke='#fff3a0' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='76' rx='18' ry='11' fill='#fff3b0' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='38' r='21' fill='url(#head)' stroke='#fff7b8' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- head shine -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='29' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M63 38 Q78 36 80 42 Q78 47 64 45 Z' fill='url(#beak)' stroke='#ffd280' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M63 41 Q74 41 79 42' stroke='#d9620f' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='53' cy='33' r='4.2' fill='#3a2a00'/>
  <circle cx='51.6' cy='31.6' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- wing -->
  <path d='M30 62 Q46 56 56 66 Q44 74 30 70 Z' fill='#f5ad00' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
